_readme: This is a DRAFT execution-preparation artifact, not a PRE-DATA approval.
It is not consumed by raptor.eval.prospective_freeze.validate_pre_data_approval
or execute_transport_and_raw_freeze, is not wired into any loader, and its
'decision' value is deliberately NOT a member of
pre_data_approval.allowed_decisions (APPROVED_PRE_DATA / REJECTED_PRE_DATA),
so it can never be mistaken for, or accidentally accepted as, a real
approval record even if a future caller pointed at this file by mistake.
Fields that COULD be verified locally, offline, without any archive or
network access were verified and are recorded with their real values and
evidence below.
GOVERNANCE CORRECTION: this record no longer includes an 'x64_freeze'
block. PRE-DATA approval (this record) gates ONLY ClinVar archive
acquisition (ADR-0022 stages 1-2), which has no x86-only requirement --
see raptor.eval.prospective_freeze module docstring and
docs/project/specs/clinvar-2026-08-prospective-amendment-v3.yaml
'pre_data_approval'. The ADR-0008 x64 worker / BIAS / Nirvana / resource-
manifest identity check is a SEPARATE, LATER, mandatory gate before
ADR-0022 stage 4 (BIAS/Nirvana execution or label-dependent evaluation)
-- see raptor.eval.prospective_freeze.validate_scoring_stage_approval.
That separate approval remains unprepared and unverified from this host
because this host is aarch64, not the ADR-0008 designated x86_64 worker;
it does not block, and is not required for, this PRE-DATA record.
SCOPE CORRECTION: this record also no longer includes a
'scoring_semantics_projection_sha256' field. PRE-DATA approval never
reads or depends on scoring semantics or the base eval config -- that
verification belongs solely to raptor.eval.prospective_freeze
.merge_prospective_overlay, invoked only when the effective eval config
is actually built for ADR-0022 stage 3+ scoring, never as a
precondition for ClinVar archive acquisition (stages 1-2).
BOUNDARY CORRECTION (independent review finding #5): this record no
longer includes an 'immutable_inputs_verified' field (or its evidence
block). Every immutable_inputs entry the registration spec declares
(tsc2.yaml, ACMG/BIAS strength+lineage, masking/predictor-aggregation
policy, ...) is exclusively a SCORING-stage input -- ClinVar archive
acquisition never reads or depends on any of them. That verification
now belongs solely to the sibling scoring_stage_approval draft/
raptor.eval.prospective_freeze.validate_scoring_stage_approval, which
independently RECOMPUTES (never merely accepts a claimed boolean) each
entry's canonical_lf_sha256/git_blob_sha1 against allowed_repo_root's
actual current bytes; PRE-DATA approval's own closed schema
(raptor.eval.prospective_freeze._APPROVAL_TOP_KEYS) has no
'immutable_inputs_verified' key at all, so re-adding it here would
itself be a schema-shape breach.
V3 CHECKSUM CORRECTION: the authorized v2 metadata lookup returned
HTTP 404 for the assumed adjacent archive .md5 URL before any archive
body GET. NCBI's archive index publishes no checksum for monthly
archive copies. V3 therefore freezes locally computed SHA-256 and MD5
after exact-URL and preregistered HEAD continuity checks, while
explicitly recording that neither digest is upstream-verified.
EXECUTING-COMMIT GUIDANCE (independent review finding #4): 'implementation_
freeze.commit'/'module_hashes'/'file_hashes' below pin an EARLIER commit from this
same PR, not the final commit this branch merges as. raptor.eval.
prospective_freeze._implementation_freeze_executing_code_failure
independently reverifies module_hashes against the bytes ACTUALLY loaded
in the running process (not just the named commit's git-show content),
so real APPROVED_PRE_DATA approval MUST re-pin 'commit' to the final
merged commit and recompute module_hashes/file_hashes against that commit's
'git show <commit>:<path>' bytes AFTER merge, immediately before setting
'approved_at' -- never fabricating an approval against a stale pin. If
the running code and the pinned commit diverge for any reason, this is
the fail-closed behavior working as intended, not a defect to route
around.
_decision_note: All technical prerequisites recorded below (protected tests, implementation freeze) are verified against an earlier commit in this PR, NOT the final merged commit -- see the EXECUTING-COMMIT GUIDANCE readme note. Not APPROVED_PRE_DATA. Only @dronasrinivas may change 'decision' to APPROVED_PRE_DATA and set a real 'approved_at' timestamp strictly before the first archive GET, after re-pinning implementation_freeze to the final merged commit -- that explicit human governance action is the only thing still pending for this record.

implementation_freeze._note: Repinned to the real committed implementation. 'commit' is the exact 40-hex commit id; module_hashes and file_hashes are canonical-LF SHA-256 values computed from 'git show <commit>:<path>'. This draft is still not an approval.
